q: How do I book a taxi in Hubli?
a: You can book instantly by calling us, sending a WhatsApp message, or filling the booking form on this site. We confirm your cab within minutes, 24/7.

q: Do you offer one-way outstation drops?
a: Yes. We offer both one-way drops and round trips to Goa, Bangalore, Hampi, Gokarna and other cities. One-way trips are charged only for the distance you travel.

q: Are your fares fixed or metered?
a: Outstation and airport trips have transparent fixed fares quoted upfront. Local rides are charged per kilometre or via hourly packages — with no hidden charges.

q: What types of cars are available?
a: We have Sedans (Dzire/Etios), SUVs (Ertiga), Innova Crysta and 9–17 seater Tempo Travellers to suit solo travellers, families and large groups.
Yes, our booking line and WhatsApp are available 24 hours a day, including early-morning airport and railway pickups.

q: Do you provide airport and railway station pickups?
a: Absolutely. We offer flight-tracked pickups from Hubballi Airport (HBX) and train-tracked pickups from Hubballi Junction (UBL) with the driver waiting for you.
